notes: Partial match, chosen as the demo case. The CV has SEO, GA4 and content strategy with real numbers, but is missing three of the JD's core requirements: HubSpot, LinkedIn Ads, and any evidence of A/B testing methodology. Score should sit clearly in the partial band and gap detection must surface these three items so the Optimise flow has something to work on.

required_gaps.about: HubSpot experience is a stated requirement and the CV shows none.
The JD asks for A/B testing on landing pages with a clear methodology. The CV describes landing page work but no experimentation.
Paid acquisition on LinkedIn Ads is required alongside Google Ads. The CV only shows Google Ads.
